# CLNP (`clnp`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [CLNP / ES-IS (P2)](../../protocols/clnp.md), [IS-IS (P2)](../../protocols/isis.md), [OSI encapsulation (P2)](../../protocols/osi.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`llc`](llc.md) | First 8 bits of the payload when `dsap` = 254 (0xfe) | 129 (0x81) |
| [`ppp`](ppp.md) | First 8 bits of the payload when `protocol` = 35 (0x0023) | 129 (0x81) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nlpid` | `enum(8)` | `129` (clnp) |   | Network layer protocol identifier (0x81 = CLNP). |
| `length_indicator` | `uint(8)` |   | Length of the header in octets | Header length in octets, up to the end of the options (Auto). |
| `version` | `uint(8)` | `1` |   | Version / protocol ID extension (1). |
| `lifetime` | `uint(8)` | `32` |   | Remaining lifetime in units of 500 ms. |
| `sp` | `uint(1)` |   | Number of items of `segmentation` | SP: segmentation permitted; the segmentation part is present (Auto from the segmentation part). |
| `ms` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | MS: more segments follow. |
| `er` | `uint(1)` | `1` |   | E/R: send an error report if the PDU is discarded. |
| `pdu_type` | `enum(5)` | `28` (dt) |   | PDU type: 0x1c DT (data), 0x1d MD (multicast data), 0x01 ER (error report), 0x1e ERQ / 0x1f ERP (echo request / reply). |
| `segment_length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets | Length of the whole PDU, header and data (Auto). |
| `checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Fletcher checksum over the header | ISO 8473 Fletcher checksum of the header (Auto). 0 = checksum not used. |
| `destination` | `nsap` | `49.0001.0000.0000.0002.00` |   | Destination NSAP address. |
| `source` | `nsap` | `49.0001.0000.0000.0001.00` |   | Source NSAP address. |
| `segmentation` | `list<struct>` — `sp` items | `[]` |   | Segmentation part (data unit identifier, segment offset, total length), present when SP is set. The total length is not computed. |
| `options` | `tlv` — up to offset `length_indicator` of the group | `[]` |   | Options (8-bit code / 8-bit length) up to the length indicator: security, QoS maintenance, priority, source routing, recording of route, padding, reason for discard. |

### `options`

- Type 8 bits, length 8 bits.
- The length counts the value only.
- Unknown types are kept as raw value octets.

| Type | Name | Value fields | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 197 (0xc5) | `security` | `value` |   |
| 195 (0xc3) | `qos_maintenance` | `value` |   |
| 205 (0xcd) | `priority` | `value` |   |
| 200 (0xc8) | `source_routing` | `route_type`, `next_address`, `addresses` |   |
| 203 (0xcb) | `recording_of_route` | `route_type`, `next_address`, `addresses` |   |
| 204 (0xcc) | `padding` | `data` |   |
| 193 (0xc1) | `reason_for_discard` | `reason`, `pointer` |   |
